tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should be a company incorporated in India/Partnership/LLP/Propriertorship with experience in supply of Indigenous Flatbed heavy duty Single needle sewing Machine for manufacturing footwear / leather goods for a period of not less than 5 years as on the date of submission of the bid

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- GST Remittance certificate for 3 quaters ending 31st march 2026
Others -- Details of Production / Supply capacity

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: In case of authorized representative/dealer of a manufacturer - The manufacturer furnishes authorization in the prescribed format assuring full guarantee and warranty obligations as per General Conditions of Contract and Special Conditions of Contract. Manufacturers Authorization Form to be provided as per Tender Document.

The bidder should have supplied the Flatbed sewing machine for manufacturing of Footwear/ Leather goods during the period 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 either in single or multiple oredrs within India.
The bidder should have a support office or service Centers across Karnataka as on date of the tender submission
The bidder should undertake that the sewing machines supplied by the vendor is genuine and does not contain used or any refurbished items or parts
The machinery offered by the bidder shall meet the specification as per Appendix 1 of the bid document
The bidder should have combined annual turnover of 10.00 crs for the last 3 years (2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26). In case of state based MSME units the required turnover is 5 crs.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder form such countries sharing the land border with India will be eligible to participate only if the bidder is registered with the competent authority as per the directions of Ministry of Finance, Government of India.
